intro: Make everyday dinners feel a little special. Jasie’s seat and tall, quilted back invite you to linger in comfort, while a natural frame grounds your space with quiet, effortless charm.

features.title: Softer seating for long dinners
features.text: Thick 24 kg/m³ foam and an upholstered seat and back keep you comfortable through breakfasts, long chats, and weekend meals, so you stay present at the table instead of shifting and fidgeting.

features.title: High back that supports your posture
features.text: The tall, gently angular backrest supports your spine and shoulders, helping you sit upright without strain, whether you are catching up with friends or helping with homework after dinner.

features.title: Quilted upholstery that dresses the room
features.text: A refined quilt pattern on the pink fabric adds texture and elegance, lifting your dining nook with a tailored look that feels inviting for everyday meals and special occasions alike.

features.title: Solid rubberwood frame you can rely on
features.text: A sturdy natural-shade rubberwood frame offers everyday durability and steady balance, so the chair feels reassuring as you sit down, get up, and pass plates around the table.

features.title: Colour that brightens your routine
features.text: The pink seat brings a cheerful pop that pairs with wood, whites, or neutrals, giving your room a little lift so family meals feel livelier without overwhelming your décor.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Jaise Fabric Dining Chair Set Of 2
